text:
Anya (product): Quick pre-GA checklist — trying to lock down scope decisions + owners. Need confirmations on SLA targets, docs/runbooks, oncall coverage, monitoring retention/alerts, and pricing guardrails. Quick items:
1) SLA numbers we commit to for Hosted vs Dedicated
2) Incident routing & oncall rotations (who owns first/second)
3) Key dashboards + metric retention (token-level breakdowns, top error codes)
4) Docs: runbook + troubleshooting + pricing page updates + sample configs
5) Pricing: burst/overage rules and any promos for early customers
Can owners confirm or escalate? Goal: freeze for launch plan by EOD today.

Jordan (eng): For SLAs proposal: Hosted: p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 1s; Dedicated: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 500ms. SLO window 30d, error budget policy: 5% monthly for hosted, 2% for dedicated. Thoughts?

Sam (eng-sre): Agree with numbers but need to call out cold-starts for private/on-prem — exclude "initial 2m" from SLA or use warmup policy. Alerts I want:
- high error rate: >1% over 5m
- latency spike: p95 > SLA for 3 consecutive 5m windows
- KV cache miss surge: >3x baseline
Prometheus rule example:
```
alert: HighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.25
for: 15m
```
I'll file PR for dashboards (grafana) — assigning to @Jordan to review.

Lina (docs): I'll draft the runbook + troubleshooting doc. Need these items from eng: exact error codes, example logs, and a short 'what to do' checklist per alert. I'll link PR when ready (draft PR #412). ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Mike (support): Support coverage: we can cover 24/7 for hosted GA with follow-the-sun. For dedicated/managed we'll offer business hours support with optional premium 24/7. Escalation path: support -> eng-oncall -> infra. Can we finalize SLA credits / refund policy? Need pricing team input.

Anya (product): Good. For credits: propose standard refund tiers in pricing doc: 25% credit for monthly SLA misses > 2% up to 10%, >10% escalate to account exec. @Mike, @Jordan please confirm legal & billing implications.

Jordan (eng): Legal flagged that credits need automated meter. Billing team needs a hook. I'll add a webhook endpoint in the billing API. PR #789.

Sam (eng-sre): On retention: keep 30d of token-level traces in primary, 90d aggregated metrics. Sensitive logs should be redacted by default. We'll put a toggle for customers to opt-in to extended retention.

Lina (docs): Noted — will include data retention table and sample queries for the dashboards.

Mike (support): Confirming escalation path and 24/7 for hosted. Pricing note: for early access customers we can offer pilot pricing (up to 3 months) — need ops to record promos as promo codes.

Anya (product): OK — owners and next steps:
- Jordan: implement billing webhook + confirm PR (#789) — due tomorrow
- Sam: grafana dashboard + alert PR — due EOD
- Lina: runbook + retention docs PR (#412) — due EOD tomorrow
- Mike: finalize support/offers + wording for pricing page
I'll consolidate into launch checklist and send to GTM. If no objections by EOD we lock these in. Thx :rocket:

deploy-bot: Reminder: the cutover playbook runs on staging at 22:00 UTC tonight. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/cutover

Jordan (eng): acked, will review dashboard before EOD. :thumbsup:

Sam (eng-sre): ack. I'll post alert PR link when ready.
